## Purpose
The package for the agent-orchestration decision layers, one decision each. It replaces the old single `AgentResolverLayer` and re-exports the layer classes `app.layers` assembles.

## Responsibilities
- The docstring documents the chain:
  1. RequirementAnalysis
  2. CapabilityGap
  3. AgentInventory (no LLM)
  4. The concurrent `agent_facets`: Tool, Connector, Library, Model, Identity
  5. LibraryProvisioning (no LLM)
  6. GuardrailConfig
  7. AgentRuleSelection
  8. InstructionAuthoring
  9. AgentAssembly (no LLM)
- Exports via `__all__`: AgentRuleSelectionLayer, RequirementAnalysisLayer, CapabilityGapLayer, AgentInventoryLayer, ToolSelectionLayer, ConnectorSelectionLayer, LibrarySelectionLayer, ModelSelectionLayer, IdentityLayer, LibraryProvisioningLayer, GuardrailConfigLayer, InstructionAuthoringLayer, AgentAssemblyLayer.

## Key elements
The re-exports.

## Interactions
Imported by `app/layers/__init__.py`. The archetype, verification and facet-consistency layers are imported from their modules directly.

## Nuances and gotchas
The docstring chain predates the archetype, knowledge-context, consistency and evaluation layers. The authoritative order is in `app/layers/__init__.py`.
